description: Import one part by its LCSC number when the human asks: symbol, footprint and attributes from the JLCEDA/EasyEDA library into parts/<id>/. It is NOT verified: tell the human to check verification.md, and that the import is for personal, non-commercial use only (EasyEDA's terms). Never import in bulk. Needs the internet. Letter-numbered pins (BGA, many USB-C) and bottom pads are refused: use create_part.
name: import_part
